name: kaqui-typography
purpose: Three-font system: display serif, UI sans-serif, monospace caption.

do: Use Noto Serif JP for display/editorial headings.
Use Space Mono for labels, captions, and metadata.
dont: Do not use display font for body copy.
Do not use sans-serif for captions.

code.example:
font-family: var(--font-display); /* display */
font-family: var(--font-sans);    /* UI */
font-family: var(--font-mono);    /* captions */
